regime_context: Policy intent is to suppress long-end yields structurally while holding easing credibility hostage to a strict inflation mandate; the market is more dovish than the Fed (end-2026 gap -14bp), and the collapse of the Iran ceasefire adds an upside oil shock to the reflation quadrant. The consensus still narrates a 'coordinated Fed-Treasury pivot'; revealed preference shows the Fed defending the 2% framework first and Treasury using issuance as the real easing channel, so the actual trade is front-end carry and strategic re-industrialization, not duration.
regime_context_zh: 政策意图是结构性地压低长端收益率，同时把宽松的可信度押在严格的通胀目标上；市场比美联储更鸽派（2026 年底缺口 -14bp），伊朗停火破裂给再通胀象限增添了油价上行冲击。共识仍在讲述“美联储-财政部协同转向”；而显现出的偏好是美联储优先捍卫 2% 框架、财政部以发债作为真正的宽松渠道，因此实际交易应放在前端利差和战略性再工业化，而不是久期。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: With core PCE at 3.4% y/y, CME FedWatch pricing >70% odds of a September hike, and Warsh signaling inflation-mandate first, long-duration real yields face repricing risk. Treasury's structural yield suppression works on the front end, leaving TLT exposed to the hawkish Fed leg.
theses.thesis_zh: 核心 PCE 同比 3.4%，CME FedWatch 定价 9 月加息概率 >70%，沃什以通胀目标为先，长久期实际收益率面临重新定价风险。财政部的结构性收益率压制作用于前端，使 TLT 暴露在美联储鹰派路径之下。
evidence: May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y, highest since Oct-2023
Warsh Sintra response held hawkish line, declined to signal July
Market more dovish than Fed: end-2026 gap -14bp
theses.dissent: Dealer-intermediation reform, MBS-runoff-into-T-bills, and Treasury buybacks explicitly target long-end yields; a credible structural compression could overwhelm the near-term hawkish repricing.
theses.dissent_zh: 交易商中介改革、MBS 缩表资金转入国库券以及财政回购都明确针对长端收益率；如果结构性压缩足够可信，可能压过近期的鹰派重新定价。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: TLT 在检查日期前跑赢 SPY 5%

theses.subject: SMH
theses.thesis: The 25% advanced-chip tariff remains in force and the Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) is pending; the onshoring bid persists as long as the tariff-protection premium survives the July 24 Section 122 expiry handoff. Semis capture the industrial-policy capital rotation.
theses.thesis_zh: 25% 先进芯片关税仍在生效，301 条款替代方案（约 12.5%）待定；只要关税保护溢价在 7 月 24 日 Section 122 到期交接后仍存，本土化买盘就会持续。半导体板块承接产业政策的资本轮动。
evidence: China tech-war theater: onshoring bid contingent on clean 301 handoff
theses.dissent: A China truce expansion or a clean Section 301 replacement that unexpectedly lowers the effective tariff rate would unwind the tariff-protection premium and hit the onshoring bid.
theses.dissent_zh: 中美停火扩大或 301 替代方案意外压低实际关税税率，将解除关税保护溢价并打击本土化买盘。

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: SMH 在检查日期前落后 SPY 5%

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes on Iran 7/8-11 realized the Brent spike (~$80 intraday); energy was already the top Q1 ETF-inflow sector and the rotation is re-primed. The oil shock is headline-fragile but upside-skewed while conflict persists.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂及 7 月 8-11 日美国对伊打击兑现了布伦特急涨（盘中约 $80）；能源本已是 Q1 最强 ETF 流入板块，轮动正重新启动。油价冲击受消息面影响但冲突持续时偏向上行。
theses.dissent: A rapid de-escalation, Hormuz transit normalization, or a coordinated strategic-reserve release would crush the risk premium and snap the energy bid back down.
theses.dissent_zh: 快速降级、霍尔木兹海峡航运正常化或协调性战略储备释放，将摧毁风险溢价并迅速逆转能源买盘。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: XLE 在检查日期前落后 SPY 5%

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is a FACT mechanism with the DOE HALEU fuel-bank release and AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program both open predictions. OKLO captures the datacenter-power strategic capex impulse; long horizon matches the policy-optionality timeline.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能服务 AI 是事实机制，DOE HALEU 燃料库释放和 AI/关键基础设施反应堆项目均是待验证预测。OKLO 承接数据中心电力战略资本开支的动能；较长周期与政策期权时间线匹配。
evidence: DOE release >=20 MT HALEU into fuel bank open prediction
theses.dissent: Recent track record shows SMR missed -16.6%; the nuclear complex is crowded, and a delay in HALEU release or reactor program siting would deflate the premium hard.
theses.dissent_zh: 近期战绩显示 SMR 亏损 -16.6%；核能板块拥挤，HALEU 释放或反应堆项目选址延迟将剧烈压缩溢价。
